warnings: Pile-footing plan: every one of the 48 positions is labelled '<column>-F2' (F2 = the two-pile cap of S-07); F1 does not appear on this plan.
Rows C and B carry columns only at the stair bays (grids 3, 4, 16, 17) and, on row B, at the end walls (grids 1 and 19); the classroom bays have columns on rows D and A only.
The alternative spread-footing plan is S-03 (its own file). Columns are recorded here only, so a consumer summing both footing plans must not double-count them.
Corners are not symmetric: D1/D19 are C1 but A1/A19 are C2 — as printed.
